requirements: R1: Frontend UI for dossier report signature action

slices.title: Frontend UI mechanism for dossier report signature
slices.jtbd: When implementing the frontend UI for report signature for this epic, I want to add a sign action, so that the dossier electronic signature outcome is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an epidemiologist views a dossier report
When they click sign and provide a signature
Then the report status updates to signed
Given the signature UI is implemented
When the test suite runs
Then the E2E signature flow is verified automatically
